nodes.label: Push-only state architecture
nodes.rationale: State is push-only — the HA integration never polls. Changes arrive in <100ms, replacing the old ADB polling approach (5s intervals). Eliminates latency and load from constant polling.

nodes.label: Curated app state detection rule database
nodes.rationale: Designed to be compatible with python-androidtv rule schema for future upstream contribution. Each app has a list of ordered rules; first match wins, allowing app-specific state detection without user configuration.

nodes.label: python-androidtv upstream contribution plan
nodes.rationale: python-androidtv ships APPS dict (150+ entries) but has no per-app state detection rule database. Fire2MQTT's data/rules.py is structured as a drop-in contribution to androidtv/constants.py as STATE_DETECTION_RULES.
